title: Distinct Subsequences
summary: Count the choices of increasing indices in s whose characters spell t.

contractDetails.constraints: s and t each contain 1–1000 ASCII English letters. The answer fits a signed 32-bit integer.

statement: Count the choices of increasing indices in s whose characters spell t. Choices using different indices count separately.

examples.explanation: Choose any two of the four indices.
There is one choice of the three required letters.

constraints: s and t each contain 1–1000 ASCII English letters. The answer fits a signed 32-bit integer.
hints: Conceptual: A source character can be skipped.
Directional: On a match, count ways to use the character as well as ways to skip it.
Implementation: Keep counts for target prefixes, updating backward so each source index can be used only once.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn) time and O(n) space, with n the target length.
